checks: Public runtime_tree_census accepts only exact original R06 state root and loads exact closed3bb metadata pin everycall.
Exactly three root-provided link paths, literal same-parent ordinary-file target names and7-field link/target generations are bound.
readlink reads the symlink itself; target metadata uses stat(follow_symlinks=False); no log target/file payload is opened.
Links count their own46-byte metadata sizes; each distinct ordinary target is counted once through the normal directory inventory.
All other static symlinks, sockets, FIFOs, hardlinked regular files, unknown special types, wrong owners/worldwrite permissions and changed listed generations refuse.
8192entry cap and exact integer maximum byte bound remain; every opened directory descriptor is closed in finally.
Directory anchors bind dev/inode/uid/mode, allowing genuine mutable WAL directory size/mtime changes without relaxing exact protected link/target generations.
Nine pure filesystem controls cover positive count-once, changed literal, path escape, wrong generation, unknown link, symlink target, hardlinked target, FIFO and worldwrite.

Initial synthetic target/link/identity creation is inside outer try/finally; cleanup removes only freshly created special entries/hardlink aliases and retains ordinary private evidence before strict nativeguard.
No product imports, backend queries, network/process dispatch, native custody/admission receipt or authority is supplied by helper/control reports.
limitations: The census is cooperative and non-atomic. Queued directory names are opened with O_NOFOLLOW on their finalcomponent and generation checks; concurrent ancestor replacement races are not fully excluded. No continuous filesystem custody or universal confinement is established.

Static metadata validation does not prove current production link/target generations, byte totals or actual cleanup; genuine root-owned next status execution must run the9controls and actual R06 census.
Nonadmitting controls create only their new private fixture objects inside the admitted owner. Their report supplies no production-store or native-authority proof.
Root-provided pinned link metadata is a retained observation; the helper reobserves actual link and target metadata on every runtime call.
resolved_before_freeze: Directory size/mtime were removed from custody anchors because a genuine settlement may create/remove WAL while the budget census runs.
The initial synthetic symlink and row setup were moved inside case try/finally to preserve cleanup on setup failure.
